profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Beckman Coulter
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer and SDET with over 8 years of experience bridging the gap between full-stack development and quality assurance. I leverage a strong background in C#/.NET, Angular, React, and Playwright to build production-grade automation frameworks, robust CI/CD pipelines, and reliable web applications. With a Master’s in Software Engineering and a focus on DevOps, I specialize in treating test infrastructure as code—designing scalable strategies that reduce release cycles and ensure high-reliability software.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Conducted full-stack feature development using React and C#/.NET, and led release coordination in an AWS production environment.
• Designed and built a foundational UI and API automation framework using C#/.NET, MSTest, and Playwright.
• Scaled test suites from 0 to 250+ cases, ensuring rigorous regression coverage and eliminating flakiness.
• Automated manual system testing for medical device software, reducing execution cycles by 99% (1 week to 30 minutes).
• Implemented Azure DevOps pipelines for concurrent UI, Unit, and API testing, achieving 90% code coverage.
positions.insights: Skills: Playwright · React · TypeScript · ASP.NET · SQL · Medical Devices · Software Validation

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed full-stack features using Angular and C#/.NET for a staffing SaaS product.
• Engineered async automation tools (Twilio.NET SDK) to migrate 7,000+ numbers for 300 clients with zero downtime.
• Implemented automated quality gates in GitHub CI/CD pipelines using SonarQube to enforce code standards.
• Integrated GitHub Copilot across the SDLC to enhance developer productivity.
• Utilized Elasticsearch and Kibana to query data and build new APIs for talent search services.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · SQL · JavaScript · C# · TypeScript · AngularJS · Angular · Web Development

positions.title: Software Test Automation Engineer II
positions.description:
• Maintained and expanded a C# automation suite of over 500 test cases in an Agile/Scrum environment.
• Developed PowerShell scripts using Azure REST APIs to automate release workflows, significantly reducing deployment time and error.
• Authored compliance reports and release documentation ensuring adherence to strict medical device regulatory standards.
positions.insights: Skills: Test Automation · Azure DevOps · Powershell · SQL · C# · Coded UI Testing · Embedded Software

positions.title: Software Test Technician
positions.description:
• Built and maintained a comprehensive automation library using TestComplete and JavaScript for embedded system projects.
• Executed manual and automated system testing for 3D printer controller software using TestRail and JIRA.
• Designed custom JIRA workflows and Kanban frameworks to streamline the QA lifecycle.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · TestComplete · TestRail · Embedded Software · Test Automation

positions.title: Software Test Technician
positions.description:
• Performed manual black-box UI and system testing on embedded medical devices (Qt framework).
• Documented defects and technical redlines to ensure strict adherence to design specifications
positions.insights: Skills: Medical Devices · Manual Testing · Software Testing · Embedded Software

positions.title: Quality Assurance Tester
positions.description:
• Executed rigorous functional testing for the Call of Duty franchise, isolating complex software anomalies.
• Tracked over 700 defects in a single project lifecycle using JIRA and TestRail.
positions.insights: Skills: Game Testing · Compatibility Testing · Performance Testing · Exploratory Testing · TestRail
